run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T01:08:37Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend RequestErrorRate alert is explained by failures on the checkout path: frontend's own error spans and its span error ratio rose from zero to ~5.8% starting between 01:06:37 and 01:08:37, and every frontend error span is on POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect. The only checkout pod, checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q, is Running but not Ready with 11 restarts, last termination exit code 2, and is in CrashLoopBackOff; its checkout and wait-for-kafka containers now run image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest while pod annotations record the normal images (checkout-normal=ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout), and the checkout Service has only notReadyAddresses, so the frontend has no ready checkout endpoint to call. The checkout Deployment is unchanged (revision 1, normal image), so this was an in-place container-definition change, not a rollout. Kubelet "Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted" events start at 01:07:30, exactly when the first Chaos Mesh PodChaos object spawned by Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay (namespace chaos-mesh) reports "Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q"; the Schedule re-spawns such a PodChaos every minute after that. The observed image swap to the pause image matches a Chaos Mesh pod-failure injection, and I therefore attribute the fault to that Chaos Mesh Schedule, while noting the PodChaos/Schedule specs themselves could not be read. No flagd fault flag was enabled and no other pod in otel-demo carries a substituted image, so fault-flag injection and a checkout rollout were rejected as causes.

claims.text: Frontend span error ratio (increase over 5m of traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"} divided by all frontend spans, x100) read 0 at 01:03:37 and 01:05:37, 1.448% at 01:09:37, 3.526% at 01:11:37, 5.564% at 01:13:37 and 5.812% at 01:21:37, so frontend's own error signal deviated inside the incident window.

Summed by span_name over a 10m increase window, frontend error spans are only on the checkout path: POST, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (identical counts, first non-zero point 01:08:37, 0 at 01:06:37) and tcp.connect (7.37 at 01:08:37); GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart and the Ad/Cart gRPC client spans show 0 error spans over the same points.

Over the same 10m steps, the only error-status span series returned for the frontend-proxy service are ingress and "router frontend egress", with values tracking the frontend checkout errors (e.g. ingress 4.21 at 01:06:37, 21.05 at 01:08:37, 423.16 at 01:17:37; router frontend egress 0 at 01:06:37, 16.84 at 01:08:37), so the proxy's errors follow the same checkout path; ingress errors already present in the 00:56:37-01:06:37 window cannot be attributed with this evidence.

Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (namespace otel-demo, owner ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb, started 2026-11-18T00:30:48Z) is phase Running but Ready=False, with 11 restarts and last termination reason Error, exitCode 2, startedAt 01:14:25Z finishedAt 01:14:30Z.

The checkout container of checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q is in state waiting with reason CrashLoopBackOff and message "back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=checkout pod=checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q_otel-demo".

The checkout pod's containers were swapped to a pause image in place: container checkout runs image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest with no command or args, while pod annotation checkout-normal records ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, and init container wait-for-kafka also runs gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest while annotation wait-for-kafka-init records busybox:latest.

Among the 21 pods in namespace otel-demo, only checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q runs gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest and carries a *-normal / *-init original-image annotation; every other pod (accounting, ad, cart, currency, email, flagd, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, otel-collector, payment, postgresql, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping, valkey-cart) runs its normal demo image.

The checkout Service endpoints object has no ready addresses: its only subset contains notReadyAddresses with targetRef Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q (ip 100.96.4.26, port 8080), while the frontend Service still has a ready address (frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg).

Kubelet events on pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q record reason Killing with message "Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted" 7 times between 01:07:30Z and 01:10:30Z, and reason BackOff (Warning) 26 times between 01:09:30Z and 01:15:18Z; there are no SuccessfulCreate/delete events for this pod, and Created/Started container events exist only from 00:32:21Z with the last at 01:10:25Z.

Events in namespace chaos-mesh show Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay spawning a new PodChaos every minute starting 01:07:30Z (otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay-zv9mn, then -927gn at 01:08:30, -d2m7w, -dc4vz, -jgn2n, -ktl9k, -vxxwz, -6cwbh and -gl228 at 01:16:30), and each PodChaos records "Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q" followed about 55s later by "Time up according to the duration" and "Successfully recover chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q".

Checkout stopped producing spans: its per-operation span increases (HTTP POST, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge etc.) drop from 903.16 / 301.05 in the 01:10:37 bucket to 0 from the 01:15:37 bucket onward, while product-catalog's oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and /ListProducts span increases stay non-zero through the same buckets (6448.42 and 580 at 01:10:37; 1814.84 and 190.36 at 01:25:37).

Deployment checkout is at deployment.kubernetes.io/revision 1 with container image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, so no Deployment rollout changed the checkout container; the observed container-definition change on the pod did not come from a new Deployment revision.

Before the change, checkout's own logs show normal order processing (repeated "[PlaceOrder]", "payment went through", "order placed", "order confirmation email sent", "Successful to write message") in the lines read up to 2026-11-18T00:53:39.651053Z.

The Chaos Mesh PodChaos objects spawned by Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay performed a pod-failure style injection on checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q: replacing its container and init-container images with gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest took the single checkout endpoint out of service, so frontend's PlaceOrder client spans, tcp.connect spans and POST /api/checkout route failed. Supporting observations: the image substitution is only on that pod, the kubelet "definition changed, will be restarted" events start at 01:07:30Z in the same second as the first PodChaos "Applied" event for that pod, and the Schedule keeps re-applying every minute. The PodChaos/Schedule specs themselves (action, selector, duration) could not be read.

Rejected: an enabled flagd fault flag caused the frontend errors. The flagd-config ConfigMap's demo.flagd.json has every fault flag at defaultVariant "off" (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure), so no feature-flag fault was in effect per this configuration.

Rejected: a checkout Deployment rollout or config-only redeploy produced the restart. Deployment checkout is still revision 1 with the normal checkout image, the pod name checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q still belongs to ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb and started at 00:30:48Z (before the incident), and there are no SuccessfulCreate/delete events for it, so the container definition was changed on the existing pod rather than by the workload controller.

Rejected: a checkout application-level crash (for example an OOM from the GOMEMLIMIT=16MiB setting) explains the exit code 2. The checkout container currently runs the pause image with no command/args rather than the checkout binary, and the successful order-processing log lines stop well before the 01:07:30 change, so no application-level failure is evidenced for the crashing container.

Product-catalog is not shown as affected: its pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-q8nt8 runs its normal image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog, and the error-status span query grouped by (service_name, span_name) returned no product-catalog series while product-catalog span counts kept increasing, despite the injecting Schedule being named otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay.

The frontend pod itself is otherwise healthy in the observed signals: frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg runs its normal image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-frontend, is Ready with 0 restarts, and its non-checkout operations (GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/GetCart and /AddItem) show 0 error spans over the queried points.

Advisory: humans should inspect the Chaos Mesh custom resources in namespace chaos-mesh (Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay and its recent PodChaos children) to confirm the declared action/selector, then suspend/delete the Schedule and recreate the checkout pod from ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb so it returns to ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout; verifying recovery requires new frontend checkout error data, which this Run cannot authorize.

gaps: The Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay and its PodChaos children could not be read as objects (chaos-mesh custom resources are not among the queryable kinds; both customresourcedefinitions queries were refused as RESULT_TOO_LARGE), so the declared action (e.g. pod-failure), selector, duration and creation time are unverified, and it is unknown whether the Schedule/child PodChaos is still active now.

It is unknown whether the currently observed pause image on checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q was left by the last visible PodChaos spawn (01:16:30, last chaos-mesh event 01:16:53) or by a later, unrecorded one; no evidence shows the injection's declared fault happening beyond the image state and the apply/recover events.

No container previous-instance logs were available for checkout ('previous terminated container' not found), so the crashing instance's output before exitCode 2 could not be read; checkout log lines returned end at 2026-11-18T00:53:39Z, leaving 00:53:39Z-01:07:30Z unobserved.
fetch_pod_logs for frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg returned no lines for 01:05:00-01:26:37Z (status no_data), so no frontend application-level error text was seen.

Jaeger returned no traces for service frontend (nor with error=true) in 01:07:30-01:26:37Z even though frontend appears in traces_list_services, so no span-level error message or parent-child chain for the failing PlaceOrder calls is available; the call edge from frontend to checkout is inferred only from span names, not from parent references.

The exact alert metric and expression could not be verified: list_prometheus_rules with rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no_data, and metric discovery over 24h matched only traces_span_metrics_calls_total and traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket (no http_server_request_duration_seconds_count or rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count series were listed), so the alert's 'current: 3.5' value was not reproduced from its own series.
The cause of the frontend-proxy ingress error spans already present in the 00:56:37-01:06:37Z window is not established by this evidence.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so no change/audit record for the container image substitution or the Chaos Mesh Schedule creation could be checked.
next_steps: Inspect the Chaos Mesh Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay and recent PodChaos children in namespace chaos-mesh (spec.action, spec.mode, spec.selector, spec.duration, status.phase) to confirm the pod-failure injection and its target.

If the Schedule is still active, suspend it and re-create the checkout pod so the Deployment/ReplicaSet restores image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, then confirm checkout readiness and fresh frontend checkout error data.
Retrieve the checkout container's crash logs from the node/container runtime and the PodChaos controller logs to close the gap on the exitCode 2 instance.
